description:
Blood Donation Camp – Rotary Club of Mumbai 25
Rotary Club of Mumbai 25, in association with Breach Candy Hospital Trust Blood Centre, organised a Blood Donation Camp on 28 October 2026 at The Stephen High School for the Deaf and Aphasic, Mumbai.

The initiative aimed to encourage voluntary blood donation and create awareness about the importance of maintaining an adequate and timely blood supply for patients in need. Rotarians actively promoted the camp among their families, friends, colleagues and local communities and supported the arrangements and volunteering throughout the day.

Through this community service initiative, the Club sought to bring people together for a simple yet meaningful act of service — donating blood to help save lives.
location: The Stephen School for the Deaf and Aphasic, Prabhadevi, Mumbai, Maharashtra
